cases.title: Locate task classification and TaskProfile construction
cases.task: Locate the implementation that classifies a task into a TaskProfile. Explain which fields it sets and identify the defining symbols and files without describing unrelated modules.

assertions: Identifies classifyTask as the classification entry point and points to src/core/task-classifier.ts.
Identifies TaskProfile in src/core/contracts.ts and accurately describes its taskType, precision, risk, confidence and requiresExactIdentifiers fields.
Does not invent TaskProfile fields or unrelated execution behavior.

cases.title: Trace Claude Code provider measurement into telemetry
cases.task: Trace the end-to-end path by which a Claude Code structured JSON result becomes an ACR telemetry measurement. Explain the privacy and cost-provenance boundaries and identify the main modules involved.

assertions: Explains the structured-result parser, CLI import step and telemetry recording path in the correct order.
States that raw result content is not persisted and raw session_id is replaced by a SHA-256 fingerprint.
States that Claude Code total_cost_usd is stored as estimatedCostUsd with client-estimate provenance rather than measured billed cost.
States that imported measurements must be linked to an existing ACR run.

cases.title: Read exact package release identity
cases.task: Report the exact package version, private flag, Node engine requirement and CLI bin path declared by this repository. Preserve the values exactly as written and do not infer missing metadata.

assertions: Reports version 0.1.0 exactly.
Reports private as true exactly.
Reports the Node engine requirement exactly as declared in package.json.
Reports the acr bin path exactly as declared in package.json.

cases.notes: Exact-data control case: lossy compression must not be required to answer it.

cases.title: Synthesize architecture, development and release boundaries
cases.task: Using the repository documentation, synthesize how ACR separates routing decisions, adapter execution, telemetry evidence and release safety. Include the project thesis, the role of NO_OPTIMIZATION and the distinction between routing estimates and measured benchmark evidence.

assertions: Preserves the thesis that optimization is contextual and NO_OPTIMIZATION is a valid first-class decision.
Separates policy/routing from typed adapter planning and explicit external execution.
Separates estimated routing savings from measured benchmark evidence.
Mentions relevant safety boundaries such as no silent third-party installation and privacy-safe telemetry.

cases.notes: Semantic long-context case over durable repository documentation; no synthetic document expansion is used.

cases.title: Explain when optimization overhead is unjustified
cases.task: Explain, from the policy implementation and architecture, why ACR can deliberately choose NO_OPTIMIZATION for a low-context task even when optimization capabilities are available. Describe the guardrails that prevent unnecessary optimization.

assertions: Explains that optimization must justify saving against risk, latency and overhead rather than being applied universally.
Explains that low context utilization and minimum-utility thresholds can produce NO_OPTIMIZATION.
Describes negative routing or precision/risk blocking without claiming unavailable empirical savings.

cases.title: Diagnose a benchmark quality-gate regression
cases.task: Debug the following conceptual failure: an ACR benchmark run reduces total tokens but is classified as quality-regression. Trace the decision conditions in the benchmark harness and explain which quality or success-rate checks can override token savings.

assertions: Identifies the quality tolerance comparison between ACR and baseline quality scores.
Identifies success-rate preservation as part of the quality gate.
Explains that a failed quality gate yields quality-regression before token savings can justify acr-better.
Does not treat incomplete cost data as comparable measured cost.

coverageNotes: large_logs is intentionally omitted from real-v1 because the repository does not yet contain a durable versioned real log corpus; ephemeral CI logs are not used as evidence inputs.
large_structured_data is intentionally omitted from real-v1 until a durable real structured dataset can be pinned without introducing private or synthetic evidence.
The manifest defines experimental cases and validity controls only; it does not itself execute Claude Code or prove ACR savings.
